title: SuperScript III qRT-PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: SuperScript III Real Time PCR Kit

This protocol performs the [SuperScript™ III Real Time PCR Kit](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/11752250#/11752250) by Invitrogen. Enzyme and 2X RT Reaction mix are combined in a mix tube and distributed to the center 3 columns of a 96 well plate on the Opentrons Thermocycler module. The protocol is split into 5 main parts: * 2X RT Reaction Mix and Enzyme Mix are combined in an empty tube, mixed, and then distributed to the PCR plate on the thermocycler. * RNA sample is added to the PCR plate on the thermocycler. Solution is mixed. * Temperature profile is run on thermocycler as per kit instruction. * Protocol pauses and user is prompted to chill PCR plate on ice. * RNase H and Water are added to sample. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `CSV`: Upload a CSV which specifies the amount of RNA to be transferred for each well. The CSV should be formatted like so: `Well` | `Transfer Volume (ul)` The first row should contain headers (like above). All following rows should just include necessary information. Samples should be placed in the Opentrons Aluminum tube rack, as well as referenced in the CSV in order by column (e.g. A1, B1, C1, etc.) up to the number of samples for the run. * `Number of Samples`: Specify number of samples (1-24) for this run. * `P300 Single Mount`: Specify which mount the P300 is on (left or right). * `P20 Single Mount`: Specify which mount the P20 is on (left or right). ---

steps.title: Prepare RT reaction mix
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, combine 10 µL of 2× RT Reaction Mix and 2 µL of RT Enzyme Mix per sample in an empty tube; mix gently.

steps.title: Dispense RT mix to plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 12 µL of the combined mix from step 1 into each well of the center three columns of a 96‑well PCR plate on the Opentrons Thermocycler module; use the same tip for all wells of a given sample.

steps.title: Add RNA to RT mix
steps.instruction: From the Opentrons aluminum tube rack, transfer the RNA volume specified for each well in the uploaded CSV into the corresponding well containing the RT mix; mix the contents and change tips between samples.

steps.title: Run RT temperature profile
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the thermocycler and execute the following temperature steps:

substeps.instruction: Heat at 85 °C for 5 minutes, then immediately chill the plate on ice.

steps.title: Add RNase H
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of RNase H to each well using a fresh tip for each sample.

steps.title: Incubate at 37°C
steps.instruction: Heat the plate at 37 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add water to reactions
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of nuclease‑free water to each well using a new tip for each sample.

steps.title: Store plate on ice
steps.instruction: Keep the completed PCR plate on ice until further processing.
